newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks steady but lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks steady but lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks held steady in early-afternoon trade Wednesday, with the Dow industrials down about 45 points at 7716.
The Nasdaq composite was off 10 points at 1433.

Analysts said the market was absorbing a downturn in the technology sector spurred by Gateway 2000 Inc and Seagate Technology Inc. Both companies warned of lower-than-expected results after the bell Tuesday.
The 30-year bond was up 8/32 with a 6.70 percent yield. The S&P index futures were off 4.15 points at 898.60.
